verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm offering legal, notary and transaction services, not a software platform, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Its software-supported YSolutions unit and legal-tech boilerplate do not show any programmatic event interface, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
